item.title: Microsoft says services fully restored after hourslong global outage
item.description: Microsoft says services are fully restored after a massive, global outage that lasted for hours. The company announced Saturday that it had addressed the underlying issue and restored service to affected customers and regions.

item.title: Memorial opens honoring victims of the 2015 Charleston church massacre
item.description: Eleven years after a white gunman killed nine Black parishioners inside the South’s oldest African Methodist Episcopal Church, a long planned memorial is opening to honor their lives.

item.title: Thousands of flights canceled as airlines work to dig out from nationwide ground stop
item.description: Airlines across the U.S. are working to dig out from the longest nationwide ground stop in 25 years. More than 2,000 flights were canceled Saturday.
